about: Per-host stop ledger for data-day jobs (ripples/lab/polite.py, ripples/docs/dataday_v1.md). A stop is a 401, 403, 429, 5xx, timeout or connection error, or any 4xx under a plan whose own rule says so. A host with a stop dated today (UTC) gets no request until the next UTC day. A host with stops on three UTC days in a row is parked: no request until an entry in clears names the host with a later date (a clear never lifts a same-day stop). Jobs append entries; entries are not edited. The first six were recorded by hand from the sources they cite.
